data.name: Privileged Account Policy
requirements: All privileged accounts must use MFA.
Privileged credentials must not be shared.
Privileged accounts must be reviewed quarterly.
Administrative access must use approved managed devices.
monitoring_requirements: Privileged authentication must be logged.
Suspicious privileged activity must be investigated.
Unexpected privilege changes must generate an alert.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require approval from the Security Manager.

data.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Policy
requirements: MFA is mandatory for privileged accounts.
MFA is mandatory for remote access.
MFA is required for cloud administration.
Phishing-resistant MFA should be used for high-risk accounts where supported.
monitoring_requirements: MFA failures must be logged.
Repeated MFA failures must be investigated.
MFA enrolment and method changes must be monitored.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require documented risk acceptance from the Security Manager.

data.name: Password and Credential Management Policy
requirements: Corporate passwords must be unique.
Passwords must not be stored in source code.
Service account credentials must be stored in an approved secret-management system.
Compromised credentials must be rotated immediately.
monitoring_requirements: Credential exposure alerts must be investigated.
Service account use must be logged.
Authentication anomalies must be monitored.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require approval from the Security Manager and documented compensating controls.

data.name: Phishing and Email Security Policy
requirements: Users must report suspected phishing.
Macros from untrusted documents must be blocked.
External email links must be inspected by security controls.
Users must not enter corporate credentials into unverified pages.
monitoring_requirements: Malicious email campaigns must be monitored.
Reported phishing messages must be analysed.
Suspicious mailbox forwarding rules must be investigated.
data.exceptions: Security Operations may approve temporary exceptions for controlled security testing.

data.name: Cloud Security and IAM Policy
requirements: Cloud resources must use least-privilege IAM.
Public access must be explicitly approved.
Production IAM changes must be auditable.
Cloud secrets must not be embedded in source code.
monitoring_requirements: Public resource exposure must be continuously monitored.
IAM privilege changes must be logged.
Unexpected resource creation must generate an alert.
Cloud audit logs must be retained.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require approval from the Cloud Security Owner and Security Manager.

data.name: Endpoint and Removable Media Policy
requirements: Only managed endpoints may access corporate resources.
Unauthorised software must not be installed.
Removable media must be controlled by endpoint security.
Endpoint protection must remain enabled.
monitoring_requirements: Endpoint security alerts must be investigated.
Unauthorised software installations must be logged.
USB device activity must be monitored where technically possible.
data.exceptions: Security Operations may approve temporary exceptions for testing or forensic work.

data.name: Vulnerability and Patch Management Policy
requirements: Critical internet-facing vulnerabilities must be prioritised.
Production systems must use supported software versions.
Critical vulnerabilities must have documented remediation plans.
Container and application dependencies must be scanned before production release.
monitoring_requirements: Vulnerability scans must run regularly.
Internet-facing assets must be monitored for new critical vulnerabilities.
Unpatched critical systems must be reported to Security Operations.
data.exceptions: Risk exceptions require approval from the Security Manager and system owner.

data.name: Data Protection and DLP Policy
requirements: Sensitive company data must only be stored in approved locations.
Customer data must not be sent to personal accounts.
Large external transfers of sensitive data must be monitored.
Offboarding users must have access reviewed promptly.
monitoring_requirements: Sensitive external transfers must generate DLP alerts.
Unusual bulk downloads must be investigated.
Data access by departing employees must be reviewed.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require approval from the Data Protection Owner and Security Manager.

data.name: Backup and Disaster Recovery Policy
requirements: Critical systems must have tested backups.
Backup credentials must be separate from production credentials.
Backup repositories must be protected from unauthorised deletion.
Recovery testing must be performed regularly.
monitoring_requirements: Backup failures must be monitored.
Unexpected backup deletion attempts must be investigated.
Backup administrative access must be logged.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require approval from the Infrastructure Owner and Security Manager.

data.name: Third-Party Access Policy
requirements: Third-party access must be approved by a system owner.
Third-party accounts must use MFA where supported.
Third-party access must be reviewed at least quarterly.
Third-party accounts must be disabled when access is no longer required.
monitoring_requirements: Third-party authentication must be logged.
Unusual third-party downloads must be investigated.
Inactive third-party accounts must be reviewed.
data.exceptions: Exceptions require approval from the Security Manager and relevant system owner.
